title: The Harbor of the Palatinate
author: Ansel Lockridge
blurb: Sebastian Pemberton, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
